1. Without changing anything, do either file Properties show Read-only, an unexpected owner, or a deny for your normal account? Please omit account names and full personal paths.

Keep the existing files; do not delete the configuration or grant broad folder access. These checks distinguish permissions from save/locking behavior before a repair is chosen.
